'''Tingo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]]. As of [[3642 BBY]], he was stationed on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he sold items as a [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tingo appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Light Armor Vendor for Republic players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Tingo was removed from the game along with the rest of the Light Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
